body:
# SAFe Portfolio — conveyor buildout

The portfolio view of conveyor buildout (`01a1d039-0d24-7d16-ae52-4841e96ccfac`): what the record holds, the strategic themes the programme measures itself on, and the benefit links that connect each theme to an outcome, an output and a capability.

## Portfolio canvas

The record summarises the programme as 48 projects — 26 closed, 21 active and 1 archived — across 14 tranches, counted from programme.json#/projects. It also counts 7 benefits, 20 cadences, 3 baselines and 56 register items.

## Strategic themes

Seven benefit profiles are recorded, references `B1` to `B7`. B1, B6 and B7 are `active` with a measured or instrumented baseline; B2 to B5 are `draft` with the baseline "not measured - no instrument exists (recorded as a kata on the kata project)". Every profile names the same benefit owner job, `01a1db6b-4f17-7e76-838d-590d71578ad1`.

| Ref | Description | Category | Status | Baseline | Target | Project id |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| B1 | Auditable decisions | governance | active | 105 approval_decision / 662 run at 2026-11-22 (decisions per run, 0.15861) | every choice has a decision row | none recorded |
| B2 | Less bespoke tooling | programme benefit | draft | not measured - no instrument exists | every service a job uses is a toolkit; a toolkit with no calls in a cycle is retired or justified | 01a1d039-0d37-730f-8f8a-2f50e5a0933d |
| B3 | Self-development | programme benefit | draft | not measured - no instrument exists | one self-development run reaches live verification on evidence; a second is repeatable | 01a1d039-0d34-7973-8989-0b83246fc888 |
| B4 | Public collaboration | programme benefit | draft | not measured - no instrument exists | at least one outside contribution changes a published output; every output is reachable | 01a1d039-0d39-7414-b43c-450de170ffe1 |
| B5 | One model | programme benefit | draft | not measured - no instrument exists | the T0 gate exists and refuses a second store; the registry has one home | 01a1d039-0d32-7734-98da-fb7f1e2386c7 |
| B6 | Predictable delivery | delivery | active | check-registers at /tmp/conveyor-526-reg-snap (open register findings, 28.0) | the seed, coverage and published checklist agree at every tranche review | 01a1dcb8-d24b-76de-b901-56fd56e001bc |
| B7 | Tokens per accepted deliverable | efficiency | active | 9,458,468 inference tokens / 15 demo-credited deliverables at 2026-11-22 (630565 per deliverable) | 20% reduction on the primary denominator (tokens per demo-credited deliverable, 504452) | none recorded |

B1's KPI is `decisions per run` at 0.15861, measured by counting decision rows per run from the action ledger; its risk reference is R7. B6's KPI is `open register findings` at 28.0, measured from coverage.json and seed/programme.json regenerated and checked in CI; its risk reference is R2. B7's KPIs are `tokens per demo-credited deliverable` (baseline 630565, target 504452, measured as inference ledger total tokens / demo-credited deliverables) and `run failure rate` with ceiling "baseline + 0.5pp"; its risk reference is R10. B2 records the risk that "the unowned fleet keeps growing while toolkits wait", B3 that "the CI queue or a flaky gate makes the loop unusable", B4 that "unreviewed public input or spam", and B5 that "a parallel store appears as a convenience". Record ids: B1 `01a1e9de-4e4f-757e-a8c8-bf3522e5adcf`, B2 `01a1e9df-0308-7fdc-8492-32db1e582a2d`, B3 `01a1e9df-0c4b-7807-b35c-5810ec418d45`, B4 `01a1e9df-1592-79a5-839e-037d8fe4251b`, B5 `01a1e9df-1e42-7199-87e1-23c577c62f8e`, B6 `01a1e9df-27b8-7827-ae4e-6d48ca5904e8`, B7 `01a204d2-dbf6-750a-a031-9f00f5fe7754`.

## Value streams

Six benefit links are recorded, each tying a benefit profile to an operational outcome, a delivered output, a strategic objective and the capability the outcome requires. All six are kind `benefit` at version 1, recorded on 2026-11-17.

| Operational outcome | Output | Strategic objective | Capability | Benefit id | Link id |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| O3 Every decision is auditable | T2 decision ladder | decision ladder (rule -> laya -> generation -> human) | every choice is traceable to a policy and a person | 01a1e9de-4e4f-757e-a8c8-bf3522e5adcf | 01a1e9df-6063-783c-a130-075067d33a17 |
| O4 Every tool is governed | T13 tool platform | versioned toolkit with a probe, binding and ledger | services with no calls are retired | 01a1e9df-0308-7fdc-8492-32db1e582a2d | 01a1e9df-6a8a-7e0c-bf4b-022848d53774 |
| O5 The conveyor develops and operates itself | T6 development project | development projects under gates | the conveyor changes itself with rollback | 01a1e9df-0c4b-7807-b35c-5810ec418d45 | 01a1e9df-732b-78a5-9b34-779be11092c5 |
| O6 The public can see and challenge the design | DESIGN-PUBLISH public site | public repository and published outputs | an outside review changes a published output | 01a1e9df-1592-79a5-839e-037d8fe4251b | 01a1e9df-7f1f-769c-bd17-8f71322cc505 |
| O1 One model, one store | T0 model and contracts | one store and one action registry | a concept has one table | 01a1e9df-1e42-7199-87e1-23c577c62f8e | 01a1e9df-87b8-7761-ae0d-f5bb03c66628 |
| O2 Jobs, not code paths | P0 + T1 plan spine | programme plan and coverage instrument | the plan and the measurement agree | 01a1e9df-27b8-7827-ae4e-6d48ca5904e8 | 01a1e9df-9066-70a9-8050-e86503fb1b7e |

Four of the six links point at `draft` profiles (B2 to B5); the B1 and B6 links point at `active` profiles. No value-stream link exists for B7 in this record.
